name: arso
description: Unofficial, independent Slovenian weather: current conditions, forecasts and station search for 146 ARSO weather stations. Not affiliated with ARSO.

interface.longDescription:
arso.lol is an independent, unofficial weather service — not ARSO (the Slovenian Environment Agency) and not affiliated with it. It brings ARSO's public weather station network into ChatGPT — the same data as arso.lol, refreshed every 10 minutes. Ask "will it rain in Bled tomorrow?", "how windy is it on Kredarica?" or "where is it warmest in Slovenia right now?" and ChatGPT finds the right station and reads the latest measurement or forecast.

- Find weather stations by name, region (including traditional names such as Primorska or Štajerska) or nearest to a location — towns without their own station get the nearest ones with distances
- Current weather at a station: temperature, feels-like, wind, humidity, precipitation and condition, with the measurement time, sunrise, sunset and a 24-hour rain outlook
- Hourly forecast for up to 72 hours and a daily outlook for up to 11 days
- Rank stations across Slovenia or one region by temperature or wind, or show where it is raining now

Every result links to the station's page on arso.lol. Read-only, no account needed. Works in English and Slovenian.

Limitations: covers Slovenia only — no official weather warnings and no historical climate data. arso.lol is unofficial and not affiliated with ARSO.
capabilities: Find Slovenian weather stations by name, region or location
defaultPrompt: Will it rain in Bled tomorrow?
Kje je zdaj najtopleje v Sloveniji?
How cold and windy is it on Kredarica right now?

positive.description: Warmest place in a traditional region right now
positive.prompt: Where is it warmest in Štajerska right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Ranks current temperatures at stations in Podravska and Savinjska (the ARSO regions that make up Štajerska) and names the warmest one with its temperature and measurement time.

positive.description: Rain forecast for a town tomorrow
positive.prompt: Will it rain in Bled tomorrow? I'm planning a hike.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the Bled station's forecast and answers whether rain is expected tomorrow, with tomorrow's high, low, condition and precipitation in mm.

positive.description: Weather in a village without its own station, asked in Slovenian
positive.prompt: Kakšno je zdaj vreme v Bohinjski Bistrici?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers in Slovenian using the nearest station, Bohinjska Češnjica (about 2.5 km away), with the current temperature, condition, wind and measurement time.

positive.description: Current conditions on a mountain summit
positive.prompt: How cold and windy is it on Kredarica right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the latest Kredarica observation: temperature, feels-like temperature, wind in km/h and the time it was measured.

positive.description: Windiest place in Slovenia, asked in Slovenian
positive.prompt: Kje je trenutno najbolj vetrovno v Sloveniji?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers in Slovenian with the stations reporting the strongest wind right now, ranked, with wind speeds in km/h.

negative.description: Weather outside Slovenia is not covered
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Zagreb today?

negative.description: Official weather warnings are not covered
negative.prompt: Are there any official ARSO weather warnings for Slovenia right now?

negative.description: Historical climate data is not covered
negative.prompt: What was the temperature in Ljubljana on 1 January 2020?

review.commerce_description: arso.lol does not sell products or process payments; it only returns public weather information.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: find_stations, get_current_weather, get_forecast and slovenia_weather_overview — current weather, hourly and 11-day forecasts and station search for 146 ARSO weather stations in Slovenia, with links to arso.lol.

sl-SI.subtitle: Vreme v Sloveniji (neuradno)
sl-SI.description:
arso.lol je neodvisna, neuradna vremenska storitev — ni ARSO (Agencija RS za okolje) in z njo ni povezana. V ChatGPT prinese javne podatke ARSO vremenskih postaj — iste podatke kot na arso.lol, osvežene vsakih 10 minut. Vprašajte "bo jutri na Bledu deževalo?", "kako piha na Kredarici?" ali "kje je zdaj najtopleje v Sloveniji?" in ChatGPT poišče postajo ter prebere zadnjo meritev ali napoved.

- iskanje postaj po imenu, regiji ali lokaciji (kraji brez postaje dobijo najbližje)
- trenutno vreme: temperatura, občutek, veter, vlaga, padavine, sončni vzhod in zahod, izgledi za dež
- napoved po urah za 72 ur in po dnevih za 11 dni
- primerjava postaj po Sloveniji ali regiji

Brez računa, samo branje podatkov. Samo Slovenija; brez uradnih opozoril in zgodovinskih podatkov. arso.lol je neuraden in ni povezan z ARSO.
